the three direct callers at 0x2005e, 0x2025e, and 0x202de are the view groups at 0x2003c, 0x201d0, and 0x202c0; the frame update at 0x1ff70 selects a view group through the mode byte DAT_0011d260; the 0x2003c group runs on the mode bits 0 and 1, the 0x201d0 group on the mode bit 0x10, and the 0x202c0 group on the mode bit 4
the function returns at once when bit 0 of DAT_00118e1c is clear or when the gate DAT_001100a0 is zero, and it saves the old position DAT_0000ffa4 in DAT_0000feb0

the race branch on the mode bits 0 and 1 walks the 0x590-byte car records at DAT_00110ab8 up to the count DAT_0010f8ec; a record whose place at +0x410 and progress at +0x408 disagree with the position and the threshold DAT_0000ff9c swaps its place with the position and then returns

the replay branch on the mode bit 4 runs only when DAT_0011d264 is set; it selects the ghost state at DAT_00118e98 plus the index DAT_00118ed4 ^ 1 times 0x24; an active ghost compares DAT_0000ff9c with DAT_00118f08, and an inactive ghost compares the clock DAT_001100a8 with the ghost time at +0x10, so the result is the position 1 or 2

the old position, the position, the traffic and car records, and the ghost compare support the name race_position_update; the record takes the section The vehicle state chain, because the callers sit in the recorded view path chain; the original has no symbol, so the name is inferred
the original has the EBP frame, so the module builds with -of+; the module uses floating-point instructions, so the recipe adds the FPU run-time stubs

the harness holds the gate byte, the gate value, the mode byte, the old position, the position, the traffic count, the car count, the replay flag, the replay index, the three float thresholds, four traffic records, four car records, and two ghost records; the paths cover the two gates, the three counting paths, the two car paths, the replay flag, the four ghost compares, the mode precedence, and the zero mode; the output holds the markers 0 through 9, a, b, c, and D

name: race_position_update
role: updates the player race position from the traffic records, the car records, or the ghost time, according to the mode byte
